resources.string: Point the camera at the QR code on the computer screen
Turn-on signal sent to “%1$s”. If it is set up, the computer starts in a few seconds.
“%1$s”: network card address unknown. Connect to the computer in the app once.
Couldn’t send the signal: the phone is offline. Turn on Wi-Fi — the same network as the computer.
Turn the computer on, its monitors off and on, lock it — without opening the app
No computer connected yet. Open RemoteDesk and scan the QR code.
Open RemoteDesk to connect a computer
the computer is not responding. Is it on and on the same Wi-Fi?
a different computer answered. Connect it again in the app.
access was revoked. Connect it again in the app.
the connection is too slow, try again
something went wrong. Open the app for details.
